subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should reply-session initialization conflict recovery be owned by the shared session lifecycle or by Discord-specific delivery retries?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 address the same conflict at different layers, and both are viable enough that automation should not choose the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Prefer shared self-heal
options.body: Use the shared lifecycle recovery as canonical and keep Discord responsible for replay settlement and user-visible delivery handling.

options.title: Keep Discord retries
options.body: Retain the channel-local retry loop after fixing replay settlement and proving safe composition with shared session behavior.

recommendation.title: Prefer shared self-heal
recommendation.body: Use the shared lifecycle recovery as canonical and keep Discord responsible for replay settlement and user-visible delivery handling.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main provenance most directly connects steipete to the affected Discord replay and shared session surfaces.
